title: Barcelona: Sagrada Familia Skip-the-Line Guided Tour
summary: Skip-the-line Sagrada Família ticket and a guided tour with a certified Barcelona guide and an audio headset.

title: Barcelona: Park Güell & La Sagrada Familia Tickets and Tour
summary: Licensed guide, skip-the-line tickets to Park Güell's Monumental Zone and the Sagrada Família, and private transport between the two.

title: Barcelona: Old Town and Gothic Quarter Walking Tour
summary: Small-group walk (max 15) through Roman and medieval Barcelona, starting from Plaça de Sant Jaume, with an English- and Spanish-speaking guide.

title: Barcelona: Tapas Walking Tour with Food, Wine, and History
summary: Four food stops in the old town with food and drinks at each venue and a local guide; adults only.

title: Barcelona: Montserrat, Cogwheel, Black Madonna & Winery Tour
summary: Air-conditioned bus to Montserrat, a guided walk and entry to the basilica; cogwheel train, Black Madonna, wine tasting or lunch depend on the option.
